references.text: The tribe of Ephraim is mentioned here with its leader Elishama, son of Ammihud, as the representative in the census, corresponding to the role Kemuel has in the distribution of the land.
Hoshea, son of Nun, represented the tribe of Ephraim among the spies sent to explore Canaan, a parallel to the tribe's representation during the land allocation.
Describes the inheritance portion of the tribe of Ephraim in the promised land, which is the result of the distribution that Kemuel was appointed to lead.
The list of all tribal leaders who were to distribute the land, where Kemuel is mentioned as the representative of Ephraim.
Jacob adopts Ephraim and Manasseh as his own sons, establishing Ephraim as a distinct tribe with the right to an inheritance in the land.
